title: India TIME_STOP_5D beats CURRENT by 0.273% expectancy
hypothesis: Under 30-day historical replay, TIME_STOP_5D exit produces avg expectancy of -0.613% vs CURRENT -0.886%. TIME_STOP_5D also eliminates all catastrophic >10% losses (0.00% vs 0.20%).
expected_effect: Gap = 0.273%. Applied to production: ~0.27% expectancy improvement per position, zero catastrophic losses in this sample.
proposed_rule: In a shadow exit engine: for every ACTIVE position beyond 5 trading days from entry, emit ADVISORY 'time-exit candidate'. Do NOT modify the production stop or exit. Config-flag OFF.
validation_plan: For each ADVISORY produced, record the fwd_5d outcome from the advisory date. Accept if median advisory return over next 5D >= median current-policy return by 0.3% on n>=100.
promotion_gate: 2. Walk-forward test on N >= 100 forward predictions
3. Full regression pass on locked delivery invariants (BLOCK == 0)
5. Config-toggle OFF by default in a new SPRINT_ID branch
6. Paper-trading period >= 30 sessions with green metrics
7. Production promotion under new SPRINT_ID with L4 evidence
risk: 5-day time exit forfeits the tail of longer-holding winners. Track MFE-captured metric alongside expectancy.
